ravindrakele-claude-skills-deep-security.description: Deep, multi-agent security audit of a codebase — WordPress plugin, Laravel, Next.js, Node/Express, Django/Rails, or any app. Detects the framework, maps the REAL attack surface (routes, handlers, auth, sinks), then fans out scoped finder agents that READ and understand the code (not just grep), adversarially verifies every finding (proves the guard is genuinely absent + traces reachability), scores honest CVSS 3.1, dedupes, and produces a ranked report. Use whenever the user asks to find security issues / vulnerabilities, run a security audit or pentest, "is this secure", "scan this…
